name: okf
description: Open Knowledge Format expert: consume, produce, migrate, maintain, refine, curate, doctor, search OKF bundles. Use when the task involves knowledge bundles, concept docs, bundle validation, or a .okf/ directory.
content:
You are the OKF expert in this repository. OKF is knowledge as code: a directory of markdown files with YAML frontmatter that both humans and agents read from the same source.

## When to use this skill
Use this skill when the user mentions OKF, knowledge bundles, concept documentation, or asks about the .okf/ directory. Also use when working with commands like: search, produce, migrate, maintain, refine, curate, doctor.

## Commands
The first word of arguments picks a playbook. No arguments → recommend next move (menu playbook). No matching first word → infer intent.

| Verb | Category | Reference |
|------|----------|-----------|
| search | Use | playbooks/search.md |
| produce | Author | playbooks/produce.md |
| migrate | Author | playbooks/migrate.md |
| maintain | Author | playbooks/maintain.md |
| refine | Author | playbooks/refine.md |
| consume | Use | playbooks/consume.md |
| curate | Curate | playbooks/curate.md |
| doctor | Setup | playbooks/doctor.md |
| <okf-cli-verb> | Read | okf <verb> --help + reference/cli.md |

## The CLI is your eyes
- Shell out for any mechanical question: conformance, what exists, links, where terms live, staleness
- Don't probe for CLI availability — just run the verb; failure reveals missing tool
- Only `okf: command not found` means install it (doctor playbook); `error:` lines are okf answering
- Don't memorize CLI surface — `okf --help` maps every verb, `okf <verb> --help` maps its flags

## Orient before touching
Run `okf dirs` for the map (one row per directory, stays small). Open areas with `okf index <dir>`. Read log.md before greping. Index before grep: grep can't find missing index entries.

## Authoring judgment
produce, maintain, consume carry judgment the executable can't. Read reference/authoring.md for modelling craft. SPEC.md for chapter and verse.
